name: Plugin theme override (each plugin's own tokens over the app's theme)
description: Every plugin UI gets a theme override on top of the app's (axHub) theme: Settings → Plugins → <plugin> → Appearance has a Theme override switch and a collapsible container with every layout, colour, style and animation token, edited as a grouped form, a token tree (tri-state groups, search) or raw JSON; copy from another plugin or a colour / style theme asset; reset per token, group or all; live preview. Switch it from right-click inside any plugin UI, the toolbar button or Plugins ▸ All plugins ▸ <plugin> ▸ Theme override. Stored as setting axf.plugin.<id>.look = { on, tokens: { "--fx-…": value } }, applied as CSS variables on every root carrying data-axf-plugin="<id>". withPluginTheme(lib, {id, name}) wraps a plugin's web library (no per-plugin code). Built Oct 28 2026 (Opus); not a cross-port contract (Fable plugin-theme@1 skipped).

placeholders.note: Compose port (a scoped AxfTheme per plugin) — Android on hold.
plugin-theme@1 contract, scoped engine and fixture (Fable) — skipped by Brett Oct 28 2026; this storage shape is what it would adopt.
